script: Everyone is paying for AI tools that already exist for free, and the first one on this list cuts your usage bill by more than half. Every one of these has tens of thousands of stars. Number one, caveman. This makes Claude talk in short broken sentences, and it cuts about 65 % of your tokens. Everyone laughs at this one until they watch their usage stop dropping. Number two, UIUX Pro Max. This gives Claude actual design taste, so you stop getting that same purple gradient every time. Number three, agency agents. 267 ready -made expert roles you can just drop in. A designer, an engineer, a copywriter, whatever the job needs. Number four, agent memory. Your agent finally remembers your project before session, so you stop needing to re -explain the same thing every morning. Five, last 30 days. It researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, and Hacker News, then hands you one grounded summary. Six, open montage. A full video production system that runs on agents. And number seven ties the whole thing together. Orca. You can run an entire fleet of agents in parallel and watch them work at once. I have every one of these repos in one dock, plus three more that did not fit. Comment open.
